Scuba Diving at Mocean

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-1c0adbbe elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Take your first breath underwater with us and discover why Sumbawa is one of Indonesia’s best-kept diving secrets. Our Discover Scuba Diving program is designed especially for beginners who want a real ocean adventure, no certification needed, just curiosity and a love for exploration. We’ll guide you every step of the way. With our certified instructors, you’ll learn the basics of scuba diving before heading out to explore vibrant coral reefs in calm, crystal-clear waters. Together, we’ll show you the ocean from a completely new perspective an experience you’ll carry with you long after you surface.

children.html:
The Beauty of Diving in Sumbawa

Discover More Experience

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-71ba0577 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Sumbawa is one of Indonesia’s most untouched diving destinations, and we’re proud to share it with you. With warm waters, excellent visibility, and thriving coral reefs, our island offers the perfect setting for first-time divers. Because there are no crowds, you can fully relax and enjoy the experience, every dive feels personal and immersive. Our healthy reef systems, schools of tropical fish, and even the occasional turtle encounter create unforgettable underwater moments. We love introducing new divers to this magical world, and we’re here to make your first scuba adventure in Sumbawa truly special.

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-782ebb71 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Discover Scuba Diving is created for anyone who wants to experience the underwater world without committing to a full certification course. The program is suitable for beginners, travelers, and adventure seekers looking for a safe and memorable introduction to scuba diving. Participants must be at least 10 years old and in good general health. No prior diving experience is required—our instructors guide you step by step, ensuring comfort, safety, and confidence throughout the experience.

children.html:
Who can try Discover Scuba Diving?

Anyone aged 10 and above in good health can join. No prior diving experience or certification is required.

What is included in the program?

You’ll get a pool session, guided dives, full equipment, professional instructor supervision, and personalized safety briefings.

Is it safe for beginners?

Yes. Our certified instructors guide you step by step, ensuring comfort, safety, and confidence throughout the experience.

What marine life can I see in Sumbawa?

Expect vibrant coral reefs, schools of tropical fish, and sometimes turtles in calm, clear waters.

How much does it cost?

The program with one pool lesson and one beach dive is IDR 1,980,000. The program with one pool lesson and two boat dives is IDR 2,640,000. Both include full equipment and a PADI instructor.
